in_hebrew.name: נטלינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word natal (נטל), meaning given, born, or taken. The feminine form natalit (נטלית) means given, born, or taken, and the suffix -ina is a diminutive or pet form.

in_greek.name: Ναταλίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word natalína (ναταλίνα), meaning given, born, or taken. The name is a combination of the words natal (ναταλ), meaning birth, and the diminutive suffix -ina.

in_latin.name: Natalina
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word natalis (nātalīs), meaning relating to birth. The name Natalina is a feminine form of the masculine name Natalis, meaning born on the Nativity of Christ day.
